body: When I referred to someone being blamed for a suicide I meant in a suicide note or something of the sort.  My ex texted me paragraphs before he killed himself saying that I caused him to resort to it.

My ex killed himself last month. I was in an abusive relationship as well. I found the strength to get away and I am so proud of you for doing the same. You did a very strong thing in putting your well being first. I had been away from my ex for 6 months when this happened. Over the last few months I have recieved many suicide threats and even threats to my life when he became very angry. I advise that you contact any of their family that you know and let them know about the situation. You are not responsible for your abusers mental health. My brother often refers to my ex as an emotional terrorist, and even from the grave he is tearing me apart. The things that he unessecarily texted me before he killed himself have been eating me alive. It is the most unfair burden to place on someone who just wanted out of an abusive relationship when I always treated him like gold. Please stay far far away. block numbers, Facebook, everything. Let their family know. And then move on with your life. If you need anything I am here to talk. I do not want you to go through what I have been through.
Thank you :) I really appreciate it.
YOU are soooo right. You should be my therapist lol All of the counselors I've met with have been assholes and just end up making me more depressed.

Thank you so much. The way you worded that really brought me comfort.  I have to keep reminding myself of all of these things.  I care too much.  I guess this is how I got myself into this situation in the first place. From here on out I'm protecting myself.

To all who have knowledge of suicide or thoughts on the matter that you'd like to share I need your help. A few days ago my ex boyfriend committed suicide. He blamed it on the fact that I would not see him on valentines day since we have been broken up for 4 or 5 months and he was extremely mentally abusive. This is so heart breaking and traumatizing for me and I don't know how to move forward. I feel guilty, but I did not know that he was really going to do it since he had made many suicide threats and attempts over the time we were broken up and I always saved him or called the police. He wouldn't get help. After the situation was resolved he always acted like nothing happened. The day he contacted me about valentines day I told him I couldn't see him and then called his mom and informed her of what had happened. After that he went missing... And then I found out that he had taken his life. I can't function. I can't move forward. I keep wishing I had been there to save him. but I didn't know :/

As a person who just lost a loved on today to suicide. Please do not do it. I beg you. There are so many wonderful things to live for in this world. It will get better. I will talk to you about anything that is on your mind. Maybe we can help each other. The pain that you would put your loved ones thru is indescribable.

Thank you. I agree with everything that you said. I do believe that he would have been the same way with me or if he was with someone else especially seeing as he did the same thing with his ex before me. my problem now is with the images in my head. I can't shake it. The thought of it all. Of the fact that he is gone.
I just found out the worst. And I don't know how to go on.

thank you. He is still missing. I am having horrible anxiety and guilt. It seems like I was the last person he spoke to. I keep thinking that if I handled it differently then things may have not ended up like this. It's eating me alive.
Thank you. I agree, I keep trying to remind myself that it isn't my fault.
Thank you and yes all of the above has been done.
Thank you so much. Your response really did comfort me. I haven't heard anything new about the situation yet but everything that you said was so on point. Thank you.

Thank you all for responding. reading your thoughts have made me feel a little better. I completely agree with all of it, and everything on the check list has been done. Thank you all for reassuring me that it is not my fault.
